latest_release.name: v2.4.0
latest_release.body:
SurfSense is now free. Every feature, the jobs included, works without a license or a trial, and all of SurfSense is open source under Apache-2.0. The [changelog](https://www.surfsense.com/changelog) lists what's new.

## Important

- **Online services end on 27 November.** License activation and trials, the plugins SurfSense hosted on plugins.surfsense.com, and SurfSense's hosted web search stop then. Third-party plugins keep working.
- **Web search needs your own server.** To search from Add from the web and the agent, add a SearXNG server in Settings › Network. Links you paste still open without one.
- **Later versions are signed under a new name.** After this release, SurfSense is signed in its maintainer's own name instead of SurfSense Inc.'s. Updates keep installing in the app, though Windows may show the new publisher name and warn about fresh downloads for a while.
- **Still on the old desktop app (0.0.x)?** It doesn't move to this one on its own, so download it from the [downloads page](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads).

## Known issues

- **Windows: the in-app update can stop with a signature error.** Windows checks the new installer's signature before it installs, and on a first try that check can take longer than older versions allow. Click Check now in Settings › About again. If it keeps failing, download 2.4.0 from the [downloads page](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads) and install it over the old version. Your data stays.
- **Mac users on 2.3.0 or earlier:** your version can't install this update. Install 2.4.0 by hand once, from the [downloads page](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads) or with `brew upgrade`. Your data stays as it is, and later updates install in the app.
- **The first start needs free disk space.** 2.4.0 upgrades your library database on its first start and saves a copy of it first, so it needs free space about the size of `~/.surfsense/surfsense.db`. If there isn't enough, free some space and start it again.
- **Going back to 2.3.1 needs a manual restore.** 2.3.1 can't open a database that 2.4.0 has upgraded. Before reinstalling 2.3.1, quit SurfSense and replace `~/.surfsense/surfsense.db` with the copy saved at the upgrade, `~/.surfsense/backups/0032-0036.db`.
- **Spark-X2.6 4B is weak at Studio.** It fails many Studio tasks. On weak hardware, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B, the starred model, is more reliable.

## What's Changed
* feat(local): draw the dashboard while startup loads, and shorten onboarding by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2397
* feat(local): name sources and artifacts with @ in the composer by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2398
* feat(license): issue and renew Business on the license server by @MODSetter in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2394
* feat(jobs): job packs, the workbook-rows runner and job runs in Studio by @MODSetter in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2392
* feat(license): Business licenses in the app, renewed from the license server by @MODSetter in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2396
* docs: one Business license and the scrapers' retirement (ADRs 0080, 0081) by @MODSetter in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2391
* feat(license): deliver signed job packs to Business licenses by @MODSetter in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2399
* feat: free web reading, YouTube transcripts and search in the app, for Add from the web and the agent by @MODSetter in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2395
* feat(jobs): the Jobs screen, with job packs downloaded from the license server by @MODSetter in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2400
* feat(www): sell Business behind NEXT_PUBLIC_BUSINESS_LAUNCHED, off until launch day by @MODSetter in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2393
* feat(usage): cohort retention and days used, with no ID (usage report 1.2) by @MODSetter in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSen

SurfSense

Air-gapped, private AI for confidential documents.
Open-source NotebookLM alternative that runs on your computer.

Download · Formats · Quick start · Compare · Plugins · Pricing · Discord

English | العربية | Deutsch | Español | Français | हिन्दी | 日本語 | 한국어 | Português | Русский | 简体中文

**Redline a contract with tracked changes and comments** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88326b9d-e763-46db-9635-75f9df9e8682 **Add sources from the web, then turn them into a web page** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/073577b7-f055-4f59-8540-330bd764aeb0 SurfSense is a free, open-source desktop app for confidential documents. A private, NotebookLM-style AI agent that researches, transforms and edits your documents, on your machine. The index stays on your disk, you pick the model, local or remote, and there is no account. | Platform | Download | |---|---| | **Windows** x64 | [SurfSense-Setup.exe](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/windows?src=readme) | | **macOS** Apple Silicon | [SurfSense-arm64.dmg](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/mac?src=readme) | | **Linux** x64 | [AppImage](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/linux-appimage?src=readme) · [deb](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/linux-deb?src=readme) | | **Docker** Linux, macOS | `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/main/docker/scripts/install.sh \| bash` | | **Docker** Windows (Docker Desktop) | `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/main/docker/scripts/install.ps1 \| iex` | > [!NOTE] > Docker self-hosts it on a server you open from any device on your network. Run the same command again to update. ## Quick start 1. Install SurfSense and do the initial onboarding setup. 2. Drop your files or folders in your sources. 3. Ask the agent to search or extract or edit your files. ## What it does with each format | Format | Research (cited answers) | Create | Edit (as a copy) | Transform | |---|---|---|---|---| | **PDF** | ✓ scanned pages too³ | ✓ | Fill and flatten forms; stamp watermarks, page numbers, headers, footers | Merge, split, extract, rotate, reorder pages | | **Word** `.docx` | ✓ | ✓ or from your own `.docx` as a template | ✓ body text, as tracked changes and comments | To PDF¹ | | **Excel** `.xlsx` | ✓ the agent also reads formulas | ✓ with formulas and native charts | ✓ cell values and formulas | Analyse with pandas, chart the results | | **PowerPoint** `.pptx` | ✓ | ✓ or from your own `.pptx` as a template | Replace text on slides and notes; delete or duplicate slides | To PDF¹ | | **CSV** | ✓ | — | — | Analyse with pandas, chart the results | | **Images** PNG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, WebP | ✓ text read by OCR³ | Images and infographics, edited by instruction² | — | Place in new documents | | **Markdown**, plain text | ✓ | ✓ Markdown | — | — | | **HTML** | ✓ | ✓ web page | — | — | | **Books** EPUB, MOBI, AZW3 | ✓ without DRM | — | — | — | | **Recordings** WAV, MP3, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis | ✓ transcribed on your machine | — | — | — | | **Podcast** (audio) | — | ✓ with a transcript, voiced on your machine by default | — | — | | **Mind maps, flashcards, quizzes** | — | ✓ in the app | — | — | ¹ With Office support (LibreOffice), turned on in Settings; it is never in the installer. ² Needs an image model, local or remote; none is chosen by default. ³ OCR reads Latin, Chinese and Japanese script. Edits, conversions and PDF tools always make a new file; your original is never changed. PDF, Word and Excel do the most today, and support for the other formats keeps improving. ## Plugins Connect them in **Settings › Plugins**: MCP servers from the [plugin registry](backend/plugins/registry), such as DeepWiki and Notion, or any you add by URL. They stay off until you allow them. **Built in, free:** the agent and **Add from the web**, in Sources, search the web through a SearXNG server you add in Settings › Network, and read pages and YouTube transcripts on your own connection, with no plugin and no license. ## How it compares | | NotebookLM (now Gemini Notebook) | SurfSense | |---|---|---| | Runs offline / air-gapped | No | **Yes** | | Your documents leave your machine | Yes | **No**, unless you pick a remote model | | Can edit your files | No | **Yes** | | Open source | No | **Apache-2.0** | | Models | Gemini only | Any OpenAI-compatible API, or a local one | ## Community - [Discord](https://discord.gg/ejRNvftDp9) for help, [Issues](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/issues) for bugs, [Discussions](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/discussions) for ideas. - **Contributing:** PRs go against `dev`; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [`surfsense_local/`](./surfsense_local) for the dev loop. How it works is in [`docs/`](docs/README.md). ## License Apache-2.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/MODSetter/SurfSense?style=social)](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/stargazers) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/MODSetter/SurfSense?sort=semver)](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue)](LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1359368468260192417?label=Discord)](https://discord.gg/ejRNvftDp9)

SurfSense

可物理隔离运行、面向机密文档的私有 AI。
在你自己的电脑上运行的开源 NotebookLM 替代品。

下载 · 格式 · 快速开始 · 对比 · 插件 · 定价 · Discord

English | العربية | Deutsch | Español | Français | हिन्दी | 日本語 | 한국어 | Português | Русский | 简体中文

**用修订和批注批改合同** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88326b9d-e763-46db-9635-75f9df9e8682 **从网上添加来源，再把它们做成网页** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/073577b7-f055-4f59-8540-330bd764aeb0 SurfSense 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，专为机密文档而做。它是一个私有的、类似 NotebookLM 的 AI 智能体，在你自己的电脑上研究、转换和编辑你的文档。索引留在你的硬盘里，模型由你来选，本地或远程都可以，而且不需要账号。 | 平台 | 下载 | |---|---| | **Windows** x64 | [SurfSense-Setup.exe](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/windows?src=readme) | | **macOS** Apple Silicon | [SurfSense-arm64.dmg](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/mac?src=readme) | | **Linux** x64 | [AppImage](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/linux-appimage?src=readme) · [deb](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/linux-deb?src=readme) | | **Docker** Linux, macOS | `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/main/docker/scripts/install.sh \| bash` | | **Docker** Windows (Docker Desktop) | `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/main/docker/scripts/install.ps1 \| iex` | > [!NOTE] > 用 Docker 在服务器上自托管，并在你网络中的任何设备上打开。再次运行同一条命令即可更新。 ## 快速开始 1. 安装 SurfSense，完成初始设置。 2. 把文件或文件夹拖放到来源中。 3. 让智能体搜索、提取或编辑你的文件。 ## 每种格式能做什么 | 格式 | 研究（带出处的回答） | 创建 | 编辑（以副本形式） | 转换 | |---|---|---|---|---| | **PDF** | ✓ 扫描页也可以³ | ✓ | 填写并拼合表单；添加水印、页码、页眉、页脚 | 合并、拆分、提取、旋转页面，调整页面顺序 | | **Word** `.docx` | ✓ | ✓ 也可以用你自己的 `.docx` 作模板 | ✓ 正文，以修订和批注的形式 | 转为 PDF¹ | | **Excel** `.xlsx` | ✓ 智能体还会读取公式 | ✓ 带公式和原生图表 | ✓ 单元格的值和公式 | 用 pandas 分析，并把结果做成图表 | | **PowerPoint** `.pptx` | ✓ | ✓ 也可以用你自己的 `.pptx` 作模板 | 替换幻灯片和备注中的文字；删除或复制幻灯片 | 转为 PDF¹ | | **CSV** | ✓ | — | — | 用 pandas 分析，并把结果做成图表 | | **图像** PNG、JPEG、TIFF、BMP、WebP | ✓ 通过 OCR 识别其中的文字³ | 图像和信息图，可按指令编辑² | — | 放入新文档 | | **Markdown**、纯文本 | ✓ | ✓ Markdown | — | — | | **HTML** | ✓ | ✓ 网页 | — | — | | **电子书** EPUB、MOBI、AZW3 | ✓ 无 DRM | — | — | — | | **录音** WAV、MP3、FLAC、Ogg Vorbis | ✓ 在你的电脑上转写 | — | — | — | | **播客**（音频） | — | ✓ 附文字稿，默认在你的电脑上配音 | — | — | | **思维导图、记忆卡片、测验** | — | ✓ 在应用内 | — | — | ¹ 需要在设置中开启 Office 支持（LibreOffice）；安装程序中从不包含它。² 需要一个图像模型，本地或远程均可；默认不选择任何模型。³ OCR 可识别拉丁字母、中文和日文。 编辑、转换和 PDF 工具总是生成一个新文件，你的原文件永远不会被改动。目前 PDF、Word 和 Excel 能做的事最多，对其他格式的支持也在不断改进。 ## 插件 在**设置 › 插件**中连接它们：来自[插件注册表](backend/plugins/registry)的 MCP 服务器，例如 DeepWiki 和 Notion，或者你通过网址添加的任意服务器。在你允许之前，它们一直保持关闭。 **内置且免费：** 智能体以及来源中的**从网页添加**都通过你在 设置 › 网络 中添加的 SearXNG 服务器在网上搜索，并使用你自己的网络连接读取网页和 YouTube 文字稿，既不需要插件，也不需要许可证。 ## SurfSense 与同类工具对比 | | NotebookLM（现为 Gemini Notebook） | SurfSense | |---|---|---| | 可离线 / 物理隔离运行 | 否 | **是** | | 文档会离开你的电脑 | 会 | **不会**，除非你选择远程模型 | | 能编辑你的文件 | 否 | **是** | | 开源 | 否 | **Apache-2.0** | | 模型 | 只能用 Gemini | 任意兼容 OpenAI 的 API，或本地模型 | ## 社区 - [Discord](https://discord.gg/ejRNvftDp9) 用来求助，[Issues](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/issues) 用来报告缺陷，[Discussions](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/discussions) 用来交流想法。 - **参与贡献：** PR 请提交到 `dev` 分支；开发流程见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 和 [`surfsense_local/`](./surfsense_local)。工作原理见 [`docs/`](docs/README.md)。 ## 许可证 Apache-2.0。详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
